With FingerprintDoorbell firmware >= v0.9.1 the adapter provisions the device automatically (server mode). For firmware v0.9, paste the URLs below into the device settings manually.

For rows with the 'Alarm' checkbox enabl: For rows with the 'Alarm' checkbox enabled, this object is set in addition to the normal action (panic finger: opens the door as usual and triggers an alarm state).
Object to set when a finger with the Ala: Object to set when a finger with the Alarm flag matches. Leave empty to disable.
Value written to the alarm object (e.g. true, 1, on, or a number/text)
Time-based access windows. Enter one or: Time-based access windows. Enter one or more finger IDs (comma-separated, e.g. 1,2,4). A row allows those fingers only on the checked weekdays within the time range. Enable 'Conditions' for a finger in the Fingerprint Actions tab to enforce them. Multiple rows for the same finger are combined with OR. If a finger has 'Conditions' enabled but no matching row, access is denied. Time ranges may cross midnight (e.g. 22:00–06:00).
One or more finger IDs, comma-separated: One or more finger IDs, comma-separated (e.g. 1,2,4)
For rows with the 'Snapshot' checkbox en: For rows with the 'Snapshot' checkbox enabled, this object is set in addition to the normal action. Use it to trigger a script that captures a camera snapshot (e.g. ESP32-CAM) and sends it somewhere.
Object to set when a finger with the Sna: Object to set when a finger with the Snapshot flag matches. Leave empty to disable.
Value written to the snapshot object (e.g. true, 1, on, or a number/text)

Place the finger on the sensor 5 times. Watch the progress under the states enroll.status / enroll.step (channel 'enroll'). Save the settings first so the device connection is available.

Quotes and backslashes are not allowed i: Quotes and backslashes are not allowed in names
Every backup (by hand and automatic) is: Every backup (by hand and automatic) is also copied to another computer over SFTP, for example a NAS, so it survives the loss of this host. Use a user that may only write into the target directory, not an administrator. The copy needs no mount and no sudo. The file contains the fingerprint templates (biometric data) and is not encrypted on the server: keep it on a volume only you can read.

Only automatic copies are deleted, the o: Only automatic copies are deleted, the oldest first; 0 = keep all. Backups made by hand and other files are never deleted.
A backup stores all fingerprint template: A backup stores all fingerprint templates (id, name, template) as a file in the storage folder fingerprint.0.storage/backups. You find it in the admin under Files, where it can be downloaded and uploaded; ioBroker and BackItUp backups take it along. Restore writes the chosen backup back to the sensor; the current content of the sensor is saved first as a safety copy. Save the settings first so the device connection is available.
The backups in the storage folder, newes: The backups in the storage folder, newest first. Reopen the settings to refresh the list.
The fingerprints on the sensor are repla: The fingerprints on the sensor are replaced by the chosen backup. The current content is saved first as a safety copy. Continue?
Reads all fingerprint templates from the: Reads all fingerprint templates from the sensor at the chosen interval and saves them as a new file in the storage folder. The interval counts from the last backup, also after a restart. A device that returns no fingerprints is skipped, so no empty backup is created.
In the storage folder, the oldest first;: In the storage folder, the oldest first; 0 = keep all. Backups made by hand and safety copies are never deleted.
After a new installation of ioBroker: en: After a new installation of ioBroker: enter the SFTP settings above, switch the copy on and save. Then choose a backup on the server and restore it. The file is fetched into the storage folder and written to the sensor; the current content of the sensor is saved first as a safety copy.
Loaded from the server with the saved se: Loaded from the server with the saved settings, newest first.
